svg.title: Cold-start performance
svg.desc: Complete response latency for 50 sequential requests, each over a new TCP connection, after PocketBase and a four-worker PocketBun cluster listened idle for one second. The chart uses the representative second run.

g.text: Hetzner CCX23 · 4 vCPU · PocketBase v0.40.0 (GOMAXPROCS=4) · PocketBun 9f5ad1af (4 workers)
